title: A Forth-inspired language for writing websites
summary: A project introducing a Forth-inspired concatenative programming language designed specifically for building websites, combining Forth's stack-based paradigm with web development workflows. The language likely offers a unique approach to web page creation using Forth's minimalist, extensible syntax.
problem_solved: Provides an alternative, more elegant approach to writing websites using Forth's concatenative programming model instead of traditional HTML/CSS/JS workflows.
why_valuable: Forth-inspired languages offer extreme simplicity, extensibility, and direct control over computation, making web development potentially more expressive and minimal.
